//: Non-secret settings for the onboarding flow. The starter repository is the single source of the app shape Keshet builds; onboarding clones it fresh as the new base. NOTHING SECRET GOES IN THIS FILE.

starter.//: Where the clean starter base comes from. cloneUrl is what `git clone` receives; branch is the ref taken as the base.

output.//: The new base lands in a sibling folder next to the source project. The folder name is the source folder name plus this suffix; if that path is taken, a numeric suffix is added (-kst-2, -kst-3, ...).
